name: Citizenship by Naturalisation

requirements.blocker_text: An aggregate period of not less than 10 years' residence in Botswana.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 10 years of aggregate legal residence in Botswana.

requirements.blocker_text: A continuous period of 12 months' residence immediately preceding the date of application.

evidence_required.document: Two certified copies of valid Botswana residence permit

sources.title: gov.bw (Botswana government portal), Department of Immigration and Citizenship -- Citizenship Application (Naturalization): 10 years' aggregate residence plus 12 continuous months immediately before application, Form L, police report, mandatory renunciation of foreign citizenship, BWP1000 fee, ~1 year processing

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Botswana). Directly sourced to gov.bw's own naturalisation service page -- modeled PUBLISHED since all hard requirements trace to this tier-1 government source. dual_citizenship_allowed is set FALSE: the process explicitly requires renouncing foreign citizenship by mail correspondence before the Certificate of Naturalization is issued, consistent with the Citizenship Act's broader dual-citizenship-at-21 rule (see bw_citizenship_by_descent.json).
